newsitem.title: DENMARK: Basques end week-long Danish hunger strike.
newsitem.headline: Basques end week-long Danish hunger strike.

text.p: French and Spanish Basque activists ended a week-long hunger strike at a church in the Danish capital on Sunday, part of a protest campaign held simultaneously in seven European cities, organisers said.

Forty men and women had fasted since last Monday and held demonstrations during the week outside the city's French embassy and the Spanish government trade office, calling for improved conditions for Basque prisoners in Spain and France.
"We want to protest the state of our prisoners, many of whom are sent to prisons thousands of kilometres from their homes," a spokesman said.
He said that he and his fellow-strikers were weak but nobody had become seriously ill.
A total of 543 Basques protested across Europe in support of the same number of suspected ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) guerrillas held in France and Spain.
Demonstrators alleged poor prison conditions, deportations and the death of nine Basques in Spanish and French prisons due to what they said was inadequate medical care.
ETA has killed 800 people in Spain in a campaign for Basque independence.
